notes.text: Ukuvula umuntu ku-Oxhumana nabo noma ku-Amabhalansi manje kuyisa igama lakhe nebhalansi ephrofayeleni yakhe kanye nesithombe, futhi kukubuyise lapho ubuyela emuva.
Ku-Izibalo, phakathi kweringi ethi "Ngomuntu" manje kuthi nje "Wena" lapho isabelo singesakho, futhi igama elide liphela ngokuthi "…" esikhundleni sokuthinta iringi.
Lapho uvula iqembu ku-Amaqembu, ubuso bamalungu alo manje buhamba kusuka emugqeni buye esikrinini seqembu, futhi bubuye lapho uphuma.

Efonini, ukuvula isindleko manje kuthwala okuningi kwaso: ubani okhokhile uhamba kusuka emugqeni waso ku-Ikhaya naku-Zonke izindleko, isikhathi kusuka emugqeni waso ku-Izindleko zeqembu, nesithombe seqembu negama kusuka esikrinini seqembu. Kubuyela emuva lapho uphuma.
Igama leqembu manje lihamba liye esikrinini seqembu njengoba sivuleka, hhayi kuphela lapho ubuyela emuva.
